title: Ohtani will be in Dodgers' Game 3 NLCS lineup, Roberts says - ESPN
description: Los Angeles Dodgers manager Dave Roberts told reporters Tuesday that struggling superstar Shohei Ohtani will be in the lineup for Game 3 of the NLCS on Wednesday vs. the Milwaukee Brewers, and that he had a "great conversation" with the two-time NL MVP.

title: Actress Selma Blair faces charges for kicking nurse and officer after plane incident - BBC
description: The Legally Blonde actress faces two counts of assault for allegedly kicking a police officer and a nurse after allegedly attacking attendants on a flight.

title: Bob Odenkirk Mourns 'Breaking Bad' Co-Star RJ Mitte Following Death: "This Is Simply, Deeply Sad" - Deadline
description: Bob Odenkirk is paying tribute to his late Breaking Bad co-star, RJ Mitte, who died at 34.

title: The Trump administration warns Ukraine it could cut off intel, Zelenskyy tells NPR - NPR
description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy sat down for an interview with NPR at a time of renewed tensions with the White House.

title: Germany news: Left-leaning Berlin coalition talks break down - DW.com
description: The SPD and Greens in Berlin have halted exploratory coalition talks with the Left Party amid a dispute over Israel policy and antisemitism. DW has more.
